description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page used in an Online Examination System. It manages the setting up of exam questions, courses, and navigation among admin pages, including adding multiple-choice questions to the database, selecting courses based on semester, and handling UI events.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class for managing exam setting functionalities, including adding questions, course selection, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load of the page. Currently, it is mostly empty with some commented code.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database and updates the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam record for the selected course.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles change in semester selection and updates the course dropdown accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
